messages:
olivia: quick sync — postmortem follow-up: multiple rollouts hit batch-job spikes. propose small set of fixes.
raj: yes, what are priorities?
olivia: 1) flag schema: add owner,risk,dependencies. 2) default slow ramp (0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%). 3) auto-rollback with blast_radius_cap and min_requests guard. 4) trace tags for flag_id and rollout_step. 5) recurrence detector to surface repeated patterns.
marcus: +1. will add trace tags and build a synthetic batch harness. need eng-sre for sampling changes.
eng-sre: can add short-term higher sampling for flagged flows; will coordinate on ticket.
sara: I'll prototype a rollback engine in 1 week, include a simulator to avoid cascading rollbacks. will ensure overrides require audit.
lina_pm: PM will track these on RF-3001 and run weekly remediation check-ins. owners/ETAs?
olivia: suggested owners & ETA: raj (schema) — EOW; marcus (tags+harness) — 2w; sara (rollback prototype) — 1w; olivia+eng-sre (recurrence POC) — 3w.
deploy-bot: [bot] created RF-3001 "mini quarantine & rollback safety" and assigned raj, marcus, sara, olivia. :white_check_mark: 
raj: will update runbooks with explicit kill-switch steps and dependency pre-checks.
marcus: UI note: show projected blast radius per rollout step and warn when above org policy.
olivia: thanks all. next touchpoint Fri 10am. update RF-3001 if you need to reassign. :pray:
